revenue_scope: Talicia net revenues as stated by RedHill
moa: proton pump inhibitor (omeprazole) combined with two antibiotics (amoxicillin, rifabutin)

approval_evidence.quote: 11/01/2019 ORIG-1 Approval (Drugs@FDA, Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals)

launch_evidence.quote: an increase in units sold for both Movantik®, which was acquired by us in April 2020, and Talicia®, which we launched in March 2020

annual_basis: Calendar years 2022 to 2024 from the Talicia net revenue sentences in RedHill's annual reports on Form 20-F for 2023 and 2024; the 2022 figure is the prior-year figure in the 2023 report.
series_start_reason: RedHill's annual reports for 2020, 2021 and 2022 and its quarterly releases name Talicia only as a driver of total net revenues (the 2021 20-F 'Other products' line is not Talicia alone and no Talicia amount is printed); the first printed Talicia net revenues figure for a full year is 2022, in the 2023 report. Launch was March 2020.
series_end_reason: The 2025 annual report (rdhl-20251231x20f.htm) classifies the Talicia operations as discontinued operations after the Talicia Holdings transaction with Cumberland and prints continuing revenues of $0.3 million from a different licence; it states no Talicia net revenue for 2025. RedHill's half-year 2025 release states Talicia net revenues of $3.8 million for the first half only.
notes: Two series were considered: the 20-F sentence 'net revenues from sales of other products (mainly Talicia)' (US$9.0 million 2021, 7.7 2022, 9.1 2023) is a wider line that is not Talicia alone (2023: 9.1 against 8.8 stated for Talicia), so only the explicit Talicia net revenue sentences are used. Half-year Talicia net revenues are also printed (H1 2022 4.0, H1 2023 5.1, H1 2024 3.5, H1 2025 3.8) but half years are not quarters. A quarterly Talicia line exists from a later issuer but is not used: after the Talicia Holdings, Inc. transaction (October 20, 2025) Cumberland Pharmaceuticals records Talicia U.S. product sales and prints a Talicia row in its revenue note: full year 2025 3,311,235 (10-K 2025, cpix-20251231.htm, with no Talicia row in the 10-Q for September 30, 2025, so this is about ten weeks of Q4 2025), Q1 2026 1,916,481 (10-Q cpix-20260331.htm) and Q2 2026 2,349,890 (10-Q cpix-20260630.htm; six months 4,266,370), USD. Cumberland sold its branded products including Talicia to Apotex on July 1, 2026 and classifies them as discontinued operations. That is at most three quarters (one partial) under a different issuer and cannot be spliced onto RedHill's annual figures, so the RedHill annual series stands; the Cumberland quarters could support a separate short quarterly series if gold wants one.
search_log: listed all RedHill 6-K filings on EDGAR from 2020-09 and read the exhibits of every one that mentions both Talicia and net revenues (quarterly results releases for Q3 2020 to Q3 2021 and FY2021, the H1/22 update, and the H1 2023, 2024 and 2025 and H1 2026 releases): the quarterly releases print only total net revenues, and no Talicia amount appears before the H1 2023 release
read the Form 20-F for fiscal 2020 to fiscal 2025: Talicia net revenue sentences appear in the 2023 and 2024 reports only
searched all downloaded text for Talicia-attributed dollar amounts of 7.7, 8.8, 9.0, 8.9 and 9.1 million

Opus re-check 2026-10: Cumberland Pharmaceuticals (CIK 1087294) 10-K 2025 and 10-Qs for 2025Q3, 2026Q1 and 2026Q2 read; Talicia row present in the 10-K 2025 (3,311,235) and the 2026 10-Qs (1,916,481; 2,349,890; six months 4,266,370); no Talicia row in the 10-Q for September 30, 2025. 10-K text: 'Through a co-commercialization agreement, we assumed responsibility for the distribution and sale of Talicia in the U.S. Cumberland records Talicia product sales and equally shares Talicia's net revenues.'
RedHill quarterly releases (2020-2021) print total net revenues only; from 2022 RedHill reports half-years and years, so no RedHill quarter can be derived (H1 and full year give only H2).

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: Talicia net revenues for the six months ended June 30, 2023, were $5.1 million, as compared to $4 million for the six months ended June 30, 2022
no_quarterly_series.details: RedHill's quarterly results releases for 2020 and 2021 print total net revenues only (Talicia and Movantik combined), and from 2023 it reports Talicia net revenues for the six months and the full year; no quarterly Talicia product revenue figure was found in any 6-K or 20-F. Quarters are not interpolated.
